title: campanula ovacikensis subsp. capitellata
intro: Campanula ovacikensis subsp. capitellata, commonly known as Turkish bellflower, is a plant species within the Campanulaceae family. It is a flowering perennial that is native to Turkey and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Campanula ovacikensis subsp. capitellata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits.
